acceptedAnswer.text: A Fixed Deposit is a low-risk investment where money is deposited for a fixed period at a guaranteed interest rate.
FD maturity is calculated using compound interest: P × (1 + r/n)^(n×t).
Yes, fixed deposits provide guaranteed returns and are considered one of the safest investment options.
